title: Link project records to exact code and tests
summary: Explore optional Graphify links for implementation and test definitions and keep run receipts with the project that generated them. Model this on BART and project-owned Test Vault evidence.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Makes original implementation and checks easier to inspect.
risks: A test definition proves coverage intent only. A run receipt is needed for the execution result.

evidence.claim: Graphify HQ links source and test definitions at pinned Git revisions.
AlderVale keeps its executable acceptance workflow in the project repository. The pinned candidate run passed and is an example of a receipt the tracker can reference.
